_doc: Sphere-phantom variant of geometry.json: the phantom is a water sphere (R=8 cm) instead of a cylinder; the world and scanner are identical. Source = attenuator, so this sphere both emits (UniformVolumeSource) and attenuates. Material is a default — the driver's --phantom-material overrides it (Vacuum = non-attenuated reference, Water = realistic). Dimensions in cm; material keys into data/materials.json.
